webster.text: Increasing in severity, enormity, or degree, as evils, misfortunes, pain, punishment, crimes, guilt, &c.; exaggerating.

example.quote: An act was passed to block up her ports and destroy her commerce with every aggravating circumstance that can be imagined.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, The Farmer Refuted (Feb. 23, 1775) (excerpt, Teaching American History)
